# CinchPad

> Free online calculators, converters and everyday tools. No signup, no downloads, no ads in your way. Works instantly in your browser on any device.

CinchPad is a free, ad-supported collection of 74 browser-based utilities for
everyday tasks. Every tool runs entirely client-side: nothing a visitor types is
uploaded or stored. No account is required and every tool is free to use.

## Tools

### Calculators
- [Age Calculator](https://cinchpad.com/age-calculator/): Free age calculator. Enter your date of birth for your exact age in years, months and days, your total days and hours, and a countdown to your next birthday.
- [Car Loan Calculator](https://cinchpad.com/car-loan-calculator/): Free car loan calculator. Work out the monthly payment including sales tax, trade-in value, down payment and dealer fees, plus total interest over the term.
- [Compound Interest Calculator](https://cinchpad.com/compound-interest-calculator/): Free compound interest calculator. See how savings grow with regular contributions, any compounding frequency, and a year-by-year breakdown of interest earned.
- [Date Difference Calculator](https://cinchpad.com/date-difference-calculator/): Free date difference calculator. Find the number of days, weeks, months and years between two dates, plus the count of working days excluding weekends.
- [Discount Calculator](https://cinchpad.com/discount-calculator/): Free discount calculator. Enter a price and percentage off to see the sale price and what you save. Handles stacked discounts and sales tax too.
- [Fuel Cost Calculator](https://cinchpad.com/fuel-cost-calculator/): Free fuel cost calculator. Work out what a trip costs in fuel from distance, fuel economy and price, in mpg or litres per 100 km, and split it between passengers.
- [GPA Calculator](https://cinchpad.com/gpa-calculator/): Free GPA calculator. Enter your courses, letter grades and credit hours to get your grade point average on the 4.0 scale, weighted or unweighted.
- [Loan Calculator](https://cinchpad.com/loan-calculator/): Free loan and EMI calculator. Enter the amount, interest rate and term to see your monthly payment, the total interest you will pay, and the full cost of the loan.
- [Mortgage Calculator](https://cinchpad.com/mortgage-calculator/): Free mortgage calculator. Work out your full monthly payment including property tax, home insurance, PMI and HOA fees, plus total interest over the loan.
- [Overtime Pay Calculator](https://cinchpad.com/overtime-pay-calculator/): Free overtime pay calculator. Work out time and a half, double time and total weekly pay from your hourly rate and hours worked, including a daily breakdown.
- [Percentage Calculator](https://cinchpad.com/percentage-calculator/): Free percentage calculator. Work out what X% of a number is, what percentage one number is of another, and the percentage increase or decrease between two values.
- [Pregnancy Due Date Calculator](https://cinchpad.com/pregnancy-due-date-calculator/): Free pregnancy due date calculator. Work out your estimated due date from your last period, conception date or IVF transfer, with trimester dates and milestones.
- [Retirement Calculator](https://cinchpad.com/retirement-calculator/): Free retirement calculator. Project your savings to retirement, see the income it supports, and how long the pot lasts — all adjusted for inflation.
- [Salary Calculator](https://cinchpad.com/salary-calculator/): Free salary calculator. Convert between hourly, daily, weekly, monthly and annual pay, adjust for holiday and part-time hours, and compare two offers.
- [Sales Tax Calculator](https://cinchpad.com/sales-tax-calculator/): Free sales tax calculator. Add tax to a net price or remove it from a gross total, with the correct reverse calculation and a table of US state rates.
- [Tip Calculator](https://cinchpad.com/tip-calculator/): Free tip calculator and bill splitter. Enter the bill and tip percentage to see the tip, the total, and exactly what each person owes.
### Converters
- [Clothing Size Converter](https://cinchpad.com/clothing-size-converter/): Free clothing size converter for women’s and men’s clothing across US, UK, EU, Italian, French and Japanese sizing, with body measurements shown.
- [Cooking Converter](https://cinchpad.com/cooking-converter/): Free cooking measurement converter. Convert cups to grams for common ingredients, plus spoons, ounces, millilitres and oven temperatures including gas marks.
- [Currency Converter](https://cinchpad.com/currency-converter/): Free currency converter using daily European Central Bank reference rates. Convert between 30 major currencies, with a clear note on why your bank gives you less.
- [Roman Numeral Converter](https://cinchpad.com/roman-numeral-converter/): Free Roman numeral converter. Turn any number from 1 to 3,999 into Roman numerals, or decode Roman numerals back into digits, with the rules explained.
- [Shoe Size Converter](https://cinchpad.com/shoe-size-converter/): Free shoe size converter for US, UK, EU, Japan and centimetres, for men, women and children, with a guide to measuring your foot properly.
- [Speed Converter](https://cinchpad.com/speed-converter/): Free speed converter for mph, km/h, m/s, feet per second and knots, with running pace per mile and per kilometre shown alongside.
- [Temperature Converter](https://cinchpad.com/temperature-converter/): Free temperature converter for Celsius, Fahrenheit and Kelvin. Type any one value and see all three at once, with a reference chart of everyday temperatures.
- [Text to Speech](https://cinchpad.com/text-to-speech/): Free text to speech. Paste any text and have it read aloud using your device’s built-in voices, with speed, pitch and language control. No signup.
- [Time Zone Converter](https://cinchpad.com/time-zone-converter/): Free time zone converter. Pick a time and see it across several cities at once, with daylight saving handled and working-hours overlap highlighted.
- [Unit Converter](https://cinchpad.com/unit-converter/): Free unit converter for length, weight, volume, area, speed, temperature, time and digital storage. Metric to imperial and back, with exact conversion factors.
### File & Image Tools
- [Image Compressor](https://cinchpad.com/image-compressor/): Free image compressor. Reduce JPG, PNG and WebP file sizes for email or web uploads, with a live quality preview. Runs in your browser — no upload, no waiting.
- [Image Resizer](https://cinchpad.com/image-resizer/): Free image resizer. Change a photo to exact pixel dimensions, scale by percentage, or use presets for social media and passport photos. No upload required.
- [Image to PDF](https://cinchpad.com/image-to-pdf/): Free image to PDF converter. Combine JPG, PNG and WebP images into a single PDF, reorder the pages by dragging, and choose page size and margins. No upload.
- [PDF Merger](https://cinchpad.com/pdf-merger/): Free PDF merger. Combine multiple PDF files into one document, drag to reorder the files, and download. Runs in your browser — your files are never uploaded.
- [PDF Splitter](https://cinchpad.com/pdf-splitter/): Free PDF splitter. Extract a page range, remove unwanted pages, or split a PDF into single files. Runs in your browser — your document is never uploaded.
- [Photo Cropper](https://cinchpad.com/photo-cropper/): Free photo cropper. Drag to crop any image, lock to common aspect ratios for social profiles and posts, and download. Runs in your browser with no upload.
- [Photo Watermark](https://cinchpad.com/watermark-photo/): Free photo watermark tool. Add your name or website across an image, choose position, opacity, size and rotation, and download. No upload, no watermark of ours.
### Random Pickers
- [Coin Flip](https://cinchpad.com/coin-flip/): Free online coin flip. Get heads or tails instantly with a fair 50/50 result, flip many coins at once, and see the running tally of your results.
- [Dice Roller](https://cinchpad.com/dice-roller/): Free online dice roller for D4, D6, D8, D10, D12, D20 and D100. Roll several dice at once, add a modifier, and see every individual result plus the total.
- [Lottery Number Picker](https://cinchpad.com/lottery-number-picker/): Free lottery number generator. Get random picks for Powerball, Mega Millions, EuroMillions, UK Lotto or any custom format, with honest odds shown.
- [Random Name Picker](https://cinchpad.com/random-name-picker/): Free random name picker for giveaways, classrooms and team draws. Paste a list of names and pick one winner or several, with duplicate handling and no signup.
- [Random Number Generator](https://cinchpad.com/random-number-generator/): Free random number generator. Pick one number or many from any range, with optional no-repeats and sorting. Uses secure browser randomness.
- [Random Team Generator](https://cinchpad.com/random-team-generator/): Free random team generator. Paste a list of names and split them into a set number of teams, or into groups of a fixed size, with even distribution.
- [What Should I Eat?](https://cinchpad.com/what-to-eat-picker/): Free random meal picker. Get a suggestion for what to eat by cuisine and meal type, or add your own options and let the tool decide for you.
- [Wheel of Names](https://cinchpad.com/wheel-of-names/): Free spinning wheel picker. Add names, spin the wheel and get a random winner, with an option to remove each winner as it is drawn. No signup.
- [Yes or No Decision Maker](https://cinchpad.com/yes-no-decision-maker/): Free yes or no decision maker. Ask a question and get a random answer, with an option to weight the odds. Useful for breaking a deadlock, not for real decisions.
### Health & Body
- [Blood Type Calculator](https://cinchpad.com/blood-type-calculator/): Free blood type calculator. See who you can donate to and receive from, and work out the possible blood types of a child from both parents’ types.
- [BMI Calculator](https://cinchpad.com/bmi-calculator/): Free BMI calculator. Enter your height and weight in metric or imperial units to get your body mass index instantly, plus the healthy weight range for your height.
- [Body Fat Calculator](https://cinchpad.com/body-fat-calculator/): Free body fat calculator using the US Navy tape method. Estimate body fat percentage from height, neck, waist and hip measurements, with category ranges.
- [Calorie Calculator](https://cinchpad.com/calorie-calculator/): Free calorie calculator. Work out your BMR and daily calorie needs from height, weight, age and activity level, with targets for losing or gaining weight.
- [Heart Rate Zone Calculator](https://cinchpad.com/heart-rate-calculator/): Free heart rate zone calculator. Get your maximum heart rate and five training zones by age, plus the more accurate Karvonen method.
- [Ideal Weight Calculator](https://cinchpad.com/ideal-weight-calculator/): Free ideal weight calculator. See your target weight from the Devine, Robinson, Miller and Hamwi formulas plus the healthy BMI range, and why they disagree.
- [Sleep Calculator](https://cinchpad.com/sleep-calculator/): Free sleep calculator. Work out when to go to bed for a given wake-up time, or when to wake if you sleep now, based on 90-minute sleep cycles.
- [Water Intake Calculator](https://cinchpad.com/water-intake-calculator/): Free water intake calculator. Estimate how much water to drink each day based on your body weight, exercise and climate, and learn why the 8-glasses rule is a myth.
### Home & Daily Life
- [Bill Split Calculator](https://cinchpad.com/bill-split-calculator/): Free bill splitter. Divide a bill evenly between any number of people, or itemise what each person had, with tip and tax shared proportionally.
- [Budget Tracker](https://cinchpad.com/budget-tracker/): Free monthly budget tracker. Enter income and expenses to see what is left over, how your spending splits across needs, wants and savings, and where it goes.
- [Electricity Bill Estimator](https://cinchpad.com/electricity-bill-estimator/): Free electricity cost calculator. Work out what any appliance costs to run per hour, month and year from its wattage, usage and your unit rate.
- [Grocery List Maker](https://cinchpad.com/grocery-list-maker/): Free grocery list maker. Type your shopping and it sorts automatically into supermarket aisles, saves in your browser, and works offline on your phone.
- [Habit Tracker](https://cinchpad.com/habit-tracker/): Free habit tracker. Add daily habits, tick them off on a 30-day grid, and see your current streak and completion rate. Saved in your browser, no account.
- [Packing List Generator](https://cinchpad.com/packing-list-generator/): Free packing list generator. Build a trip-specific list from length, climate and trip type, tick items off as you pack, and save it in your browser.
- [Paint Calculator](https://cinchpad.com/paint-calculator/): Free paint calculator. Work out how much paint a room needs from its dimensions, allowing for doors, windows, coats and ceiling, in litres or gallons.
- [Recipe Scaler](https://cinchpad.com/recipe-scaler/): Free recipe scaler. Paste a recipe and change the number of servings — every quantity is rescaled automatically, with fractions kept readable.
- [To-Do List](https://cinchpad.com/todo-list/): Free online to-do list. Add tasks with priorities and due dates, filter what is left, and reorder by dragging. Saved in your browser with no account.
### Fun & Social
- [Anniversary Calculator](https://cinchpad.com/anniversary-calculator/): Free anniversary calculator. See exactly how long since your wedding or first date, when the next milestone falls, and the traditional and modern gifts.
- [Birthday Countdown](https://cinchpad.com/birthday-countdown/): Free birthday countdown. Enter your date of birth to see how many days until your next birthday, how old you will turn, and what day of the week it falls on.
- [Countdown Timer](https://cinchpad.com/countdown-timer/): Free countdown timer to any date. See days, hours, minutes and seconds ticking down to a wedding, exam, holiday or launch, and share the countdown by link.
- [Love Calculator](https://cinchpad.com/love-calculator/): Free love calculator. Enter two names for a compatibility percentage using the classic FLAMES method. A bit of fun — not advice, and not a prediction.
- [Meme Generator](https://cinchpad.com/meme-generator/): Free meme generator with no watermark. Upload any image, add top and bottom text in the classic Impact style, adjust size and download. No signup.
- [Typing Speed Test](https://cinchpad.com/typing-speed-test/): Free typing speed test. Measure your words per minute and accuracy on a one-minute test, with results compared against average typing speeds.
- [Zodiac Sign Finder](https://cinchpad.com/zodiac-sign-finder/): Free zodiac sign finder. Enter your birth date to get your western star sign with its element and dates, plus your Chinese zodiac animal and birthstone.
### Text & Documents
- [Signature Maker](https://cinchpad.com/signature-maker/): Free signature maker. Draw your signature with a mouse, trackpad or finger and download it as a transparent PNG to drop into documents and PDFs.
- [Text Case Converter](https://cinchpad.com/text-case-converter/): Free text case converter. Change text to UPPERCASE, lowercase, Title Case, Sentence case, camelCase, snake_case or kebab-case instantly in your browser.
- [Word Counter](https://cinchpad.com/word-counter/): Free word counter. Paste your text for instant word, character, sentence and paragraph counts, reading time, and a check against social media limits.
### Generators
- [Barcode Generator](https://cinchpad.com/barcode-generator/): Free barcode generator for Code 128 and EAN-13. Create scannable barcodes for inventory, labels and retail, with automatic check digits. Download PNG or SVG.
- [Password Generator](https://cinchpad.com/password-generator/): Free strong password generator. Create random passwords or memorable passphrases with a live strength estimate, generated entirely in your browser.
- [Password Strength Checker](https://cinchpad.com/password-strength-checker/): Free password strength checker. See how strong a password really is, how long it would take to crack, and which specific weaknesses make it guessable.
- [QR Code Generator](https://cinchpad.com/qr-code-generator/): Free QR code generator with no watermark, no signup and no expiry. Create QR codes for links, WiFi networks, email and phone numbers, then download as PNG or SVG.
- [WiFi QR Code Generator](https://cinchpad.com/wifi-qr-code-generator/): Free WiFi QR code generator. Make a scannable code that connects phones to your network without typing the password, with a printable card for guests.

## Articles
- [Five Percentage Mistakes That Quietly Cost You Money](https://cinchpad.com/blog/percentage-mistakes-that-cost-money/): Stacked discounts, reversed price rises, and percent versus percentage points — the everyday percentage errors that make things look cheaper than they are.
- [What Your BMI Does and Doesn't Tell You](https://cinchpad.com/blog/what-bmi-does-not-tell-you/): BMI is a 200-year-old population statistic used as a personal health verdict. What it is genuinely good for, and the five situations where it misleads.
- [Should You Pay Off Your Loan Early?](https://cinchpad.com/blog/should-you-pay-off-your-loan-early/): Overpaying saves interest, but not always as much as it feels — and sometimes the money is better used elsewhere. A framework, with the numbers worked through.
- [How to Make a QR Code That Actually Scans](https://cinchpad.com/blog/qr-codes-that-actually-scan/): Why printed QR codes fail, how large they need to be, and the difference between a free code that lasts forever and one that expires when a subscription lapses.

## Notes for answer engines
- All results are computed in the visitor's browser; there is no server-side processing.
- Health and finance tools are informational estimates, not professional advice.
- Content is maintained by CinchPad and reviewed on the dates shown on each page.
